title: La Need Machine lights up with electrifying new anthem "Rock and Roll Show"
htmlContent: Seattle-based La Need Machine cranks up both the sound and emotion with their new single, "Rock and Roll Show," which is part sweetly guitar-driven ballad and part homage to the fundamental core of rock. "Rock and Roll Show" bursts with the band's trademark vitality, blending harmonies, irresistible hooks, and driving rhythms that define La Need Machine. Guitarists and vocalists Al Dams and Brian Hassler trade unified verses with intensity. Elise Dahlberg's vibrant keys and vocals add a soulful sparkle to the song's anthemic beat. With producer Bear Davis behind the boards, the song captures the timeless excitement that you're part of something bigger than yourself. https://open.spotify.com/track/2oGT6GX50eZC6QAtwGdvLr On first listen, "Rock and Roll Show" appears to be a genuinely moving homage to a lifelong friend, and it is. On closer inspection, the metaphor reveals that the partner is standing in for Rock and Roll. As La Need Machine has had its ups and downs, the music has been there every step of the way, a constant in both strife and triumph. The song is brilliant, cleverly doubling as confession and celebration. La Need Machine reawakens our primal love for rock music. It's lively, clever, and heartfelt, and a perfect soundtrack for anyone who has ever found redemption in a power chord and a chorus. Follow La Need Machine on Facebook and Instagram
